name: dsh-dual-bridge
description: Sidebar bundle that packs the workspace into a structured prompt on the clipboard (file tree + fenced code), then opens a split-screen DeepSeek web chat for free project reading; extracts text from PDF/Word/PPT/Excel/RTF, OCRs images via Vision/tesseract/bundled WASM, and exports unrecognized files to the Desktop for drag-and-drop upload. Fully local: no network, no browser automation, no web API calls.
